nodes.name: Every 30 Minutes
nodes.notes: Starts a poll every 30 minutes (production runs only - publish the workflow).

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: EDIT HERE: HubSpot URL, Quote / Job pipeline IDs, whether Companies and Contacts are limited to ones already linked to Simpro, and the window settings (overlap, first-run lookback, optional start override for a backfill).

nodes.name: Build Sync Window
nodes.notes: Window: last saved window end minus the overlap (or the first-run lookback). Needs Code because the watermark lives in workflow static data. Settings are in Workflow Config.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Companies
nodes.notes: HubSpot companies modified since the window start (IDs only, 200 per page). With onlySyncedCompanies on, only companies that already have a Simpro ID. Runs once; chained so each list is fetched exactly once.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Sites
nodes.notes: HubSpot Sites (object 0-420) modified since the window start.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Contacts
nodes.notes: HubSpot contacts modified since the window start (contacts use lastmodifieddate). With onlySyncedContacts on, only contacts that already have a Simpro ID.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Quote Deals
nodes.notes: HubSpot deals in the Quote pipeline modified since the window start.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Job Deals
nodes.notes: HubSpot deals in the Jobs pipeline modified since the window start.

nodes.name: Build Record List
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: one item per changed record, shaped like the HubSpot webhook payload. Fails loudly on a bad shape or a truncated result set.

nodes.name: Has Records
nodes.notes: True: at least one changed record - loop. False: empty window - go straight to Finish Run so the window still advances.

nodes.name: Loop Over Records
nodes.notes: One record at a time (batch 1). Output 0 = done, output 1 = next record.

nodes.name: Sync Record
nodes.notes: Runs the HubSpot -> Simpro router for this one record and waits. A failure is captured (not thrown) so the rest of the batch still runs; Finish Run raises it at the end.

assignments.name: error

nodes.name: Note Result
nodes.notes: Collapses the sub-workflow output to ONE ok/failed item per record and feeds it back into the loop. Runs once per record (executeOnce), no Code needed.

nodes.name: Finish Run
nodes.notes: Once per poll: throws if any record failed (window not advanced, next run retries it); otherwise saves the new window end. Needs Code for the saved watermark.
